jobs.description_snippet: **This is a software development job.** You'll design, build, test, debug, deploy and maintain real systems. What's different is how the code gets written. We use agentic coding tools as a default, so a lot of implementation gets drafted by an agent working under your direction. Your time shifts toward specifying precisely, reviewing carefully, and verifying rigorously. The bottleneck moves from typing code to judging it. Day to day you'll be building [product / systems] in [stack]. Normal engineering work, at unusual throughput. We want developers, full stop. If you can't read a stack trace and reason your way to the cause, these tools won't cover for you - they'll just help you produce bugs faster. If your experience is mostly using AI tools without a developers background, this isn't the right role for you. **What you'll do** * Break work into pieces an agent can execute and you can verify * Review a high volume of generated code and catch the plausible-but-wrong * Debug systems you didn't write line by line * Build the guardrails that make speed safe: tests, types, linting, CI * Own what ships. "The agent wrote it" isn't a defence * Bring back what you learn about where the tools break **What we need** * **Real software fundamentals** - data structures, APIs, databases, and the ability to reason about correctness, performance and failure modes * **Debugging ability.** You can find the cause, not just the symptom * **Strong code review instincts.** The highest-leverage skill on this team * **Git, CI/CD and command-line comfort** * **Testing discipline** - you don't trust code you haven't verified * **Clear writing.** Vague instructions produce vague software * **Honesty about uncertainty.** "I don't understand this yet" is a feature **By level** * **Junior:** solid fundamentals and evidence you build things. Portfolio, personal projects or coursework is fine - we'll teach the workflow. * **Mid:** 3+ years shipping production code, and you've already worked this way on something real. * **Senior:** you can design systems, set standards for how the team works with agents, and mentor people through the shift. **Bonus points** * Hands-on experience with Claude Code or similar agentic tools * **Print industry experience** - prepress, PDF/PostScript workflows, colour management, variable data printing, web-to-print, or print MIS * Familiarity with MCP or tool integrations * Open-source contributions Pay: R10 000,00 - R30 000,00 per month Work Location: In person

jobs.description_snippet: M-Pesa is a pioneering fintech business and global market leader in mobile money. Starting from 2007 as a convenient means by which the unbanked and underbanked could make digital payments, M-Pesa has now grown to offer over 60 million active customers Financial Services, Enterprise, Merchant and Retail solutions. We are proud of our work in enabling the digital economy in our markets, and in driving financial inclusion. M-Pesa Africa is the largest FinTech providing services to more than 60 million customers and 5 million businesses solutions across Financial Services, Enterprise, Merchant and Retail. We are now well on our way to becoming the preferred digital payment method across the markets that we serve, for both in-store, remote and online payments. With headquarters in both Nairobi and Johannesburg, we serve markets that include Kenya, Tanzania, DRC, Lesotho, Ghana, Egypt, Ethiopia, and Mozambique. We are a united, energetic and passionate team. A place where leaders coach, teams connect, and everyone is empowered to go further, faster. A place where heroes become superheroes; through growth, opportunity, and the chance to work with the best minds in FinTech. **Role Purpose:** ----------------- Network \& Firewall Integration Engineer within the Cloud Integration Team, focused on core virtual networking, cloud connectivity, firewall security, VPN integration, and IP/MPLS engineering across M-PESA operating markets, Vodafone Group platforms, cloud environments, and third-party partners.The role acts as a subject matter expert for network integration and security, ensuring the delivery of resilient, scalable, and secure connectivity solutions that support critical M-PESA services. The position drives end-to-end network integration initiatives, enables cloud connectivity strategies, and ensures adherence to architecture standards, security policies, operational resilience requirements, and service level commitments across the M-PESA ecosystem.The role provides technical leadership across complex multi-country integration programmes and contributes to the evolution of network capabilities through automation, continuous improvement, and adoption of emerging technologies. **Your responsibilities will include:** --------------------------------------- **Key accountabilities and decision ownership:** * Participate in numerous network integration projects, including design, deployment and testing of new flows and VPNs between a virtual core data centre and multiple external 3rd parties. * Support architects to document the essential components of core networks provided by Vodafone Group and between our MPesa OPCO’s, and their associated change control processes and SLA’s. Documentation includes architecture and design documents, communications matrices, detailed deployment plans, VPN forms, and Firewall configuration. * Updates to required documents of the relevant components of the local market networks to facilitate the associated change control
jobs.blurb: Network and firewall integration engineer for M-Pesa Africa, supporting infrastructure for a fintech platform serving 60+ million customers across multiple African markets.

jobs.description_snippet: About First Principles First Principles is a product consultancy that builds radical value for ambitious, emerging technology startups. We provide product leadership and strategic support, blending modern technology with thoughtful design to shape tomorrow's products. We were founded by startup and enterprise leaders who have built and scaled products across many industries. We work with clients in four ways: AI-first PM training and certification, product coaching, fractional product leadership through CPOs and PMs who set vision and keep roadmaps on track, and AI-first product squads that go from concept to prototype in days instead of months. Our team runs on curiosity, empathy, and continuous improvement. The Product You'll be working on a text fundraising application that helps political and non-profit groups raise money for their campaigns and causes. It handles the full lifecycle: registration with carriers, phone number provisioning and management, message building and sending, and detailed metrics and tracking. The product is at an inflection point. We spent the last year and a half building the first version and running it as an internal tool. Our client is a texting firm, and we built this to replace their existing platform with something that costs half as much and does exactly what they need. We're now building differentiating features and engineering for scale as we prepare to launch it as a standalone SaaS product over the next year, with plans to roll it out to our client's own clients so they can run campaigns themselves by the end of 2026. The Role We're looking for someone who sits at the intersection of QA, engineering, and product: an expert in test automation who also has the product sense to understand how the application actually gets used, not just how it works mechanically. In practice, you and the product manager should become the two people who understand real customer flows and what correct results look like better than anyone else on the team, including the engineers. The engineers know how their features work. You'll know how the system is supposed to behave end to end, and you'll be the one who can tell a genuine defect apart from expected behavior. You'll start by testing things manually, because that's how you'll learn the system deeply and figure out exactly what needs to be checked. From there you'll automate it, ideally writing down the manual steps clearly enough that AI tooling can help you build out the scripts while you move on to testing the next thing. Manual testing never fully goes away, especially for brand new features, but the goal is a first-class automated suite that frees you and the team from re-checking the same ground every release.
